extra_multiband_spectral_zero.scope: Blind extra training sources matched afterward to spectra at 500mas with 300mas competitor margin; many-to-one claims rejected. No held stellar positions entered training. Spectral subsample, not correctness of all unlabelled extra stars.

annual_same_errors_multiband.null_scope: Four fixed 31.6 arcsec position shifts at actual held times. Held-position chance coincidence only; not a whole-track contamination estimate or absolute PM truth.

fixed_source_held_year.selection_scope: Fixed W0-r training sources and one unique held r detection per source/exposure; 1 arcsec W0 prediction gate.

training_scope: Half of C0 held-out physical galaxies; QSO excluded from error learning.
